assumptions.choice: size = floor(available cash / current bar close price) computed at the moment the January-1st buy signal fires
assumptions.reason: spec says 'use all available capital for position sizing' but does not give a sizing formula or price reference; using broker cash and the current close with integer floor division is the most literal, standard way to express an all-in share count in backtrader.

assumptions.choice: no cash buffer subtracted for the fixed 0.001 commission when computing the all-in share count
assumptions.reason: spec is silent on commission handling for sizing; the literal cash/price computation is used as written rather than adding an unstated safety margin.

assumptions.choice: 20-day SMA is computed as an indicator only and is not referenced in any entry/exit condition
assumptions.reason: spec explicitly labels it 'for analysis', distinct from the calendar buy/sell rules, and states no threshold or filter involving it.

assumptions.choice: native backtrader Stop order placed at 2% below the actual filled entry price, submitted once the January buy order completes
assumptions.reason: spec states a stop-loss 'set at 2% below the entry price' without further mechanics; a Stop order pegged to the confirmed fill price is the closest literal implementation of a real stop-loss order.

assumptions.choice: cancel any still-pending stop-loss order before submitting the February calendar close
assumptions.reason: spec does not address interaction between the two exits; canceling avoids a duplicate/conflicting sell order on the same position.
